name: Grain 16
paragraphs: Grain16 is real 16mm film grain you can easily add to your footage. Place Grain16 onto your clips to add the dynamic texture of authentic film.

Apply already-optimized Electrify motion patterns and color schemes to your text and images with lightning fast ease. Find these presets via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it. Note that these presets correlate to the five Grain Type options mentioned below.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Glitch look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
